title: siwa law · International boutique law firm
meta_desc: siwa law is an international boutique law firm under Danish law, advising AI and tech companies, start-ups, investors, SMEs, athletes and creators.
hero_sub: We advise AI and tech companies, start-ups, investors, SMEs, athletes and creators, in eight languages, from idea to exit.
firm_p1: siwa law was founded in Denmark with a global outlook. We are a multilingual boutique firm, committed to getting business done in our clients' best interests.
firm_p2: For more than ten years we have negotiated and closed deals across six continents. Our ties to Scandinavia, Spain, Brazil, the Middle East and Indonesia give us the cultural insight that local and cross-border work needs.
firm_p3: Entrepreneurship, AI and tech, sport and international business are where we work best. We take a 360° view of each matter, so your legal work serves your local and global ambitions.
firm_p4: We work remote first: meetings happen online, which saves you time and cost wherever you are.
tagline: We listen before we solve. Openness, deep listening and understanding first. Then action. That is how a legal advisor becomes a trusted partner.

name_text: Siwa lies in Egypt's Western Desert. It was home to the Oracle of Amun, where Alexander the Great came for guidance. An advisor's role: helping others see the way forward. That is the role we want to play for ambitious clients in a global world.
person_bio: Mousta is an entrepreneurial, tech-savvy and internationally minded lawyer who speaks eight languages. He trained at top-tier law firms in Denmark and Spain and studied in Copenhagen, London and Barcelona. He has visited more than 100 countries and all seven continents, and builds bridges through language and culture.
